nodes.title: Machine Learning Foundations & Data Workflow
nodes.description: ML fundamentals, data acquisition and EDA, and feature engineering and preprocessing.

nodes.title: ML fundamentals
nodes.description: AI vs ML vs Deep Learning; supervised vs unsupervised vs reinforcement learning, batch/offline vs online learning, common ML challenges and the ML development life cycle.

nodes.title: Data acquisition & EDA
nodes.description: CSV, JSON, SQL, APIs and web-scraped data, feature types and data quality, univariate, bivariate and multivariate analysis.

nodes.title: Feature engineering & preprocessing
nodes.description: Scaling, encoding, ColumnTransformer and sklearn Pipelines, transforms, binning, mixed variables, missing values and outliers.

nodes.title: Supervised Learning - Regression
nodes.description: Predict a continuous target, learning not only how to fit a model but why its objective function and assumptions matter.

nodes.title: Simple Linear Regression
nodes.description: Line equation y = mx + b, geometric intuition of fitting a best line, residuals and the squared-error objective.

nodes.title: Multiple Linear Regression
nodes.description: Hyperplane intuition and matrix-form thinking, coefficient interpretation, and the effect of correlated predictors.

nodes.title: Gradient Descent for Regression
nodes.description: Cost surface and direction of steepest descent, learning rate, and batch, stochastic and mini-batch gradient descent.

nodes.title: Polynomial Regression
nodes.description: Creating nonlinear decision curves using polynomial features while the model remains linear in parameters.

nodes.title: Regression Metrics
nodes.description: MAE, MSE, RMSE, R² score and Adjusted R², choosing metrics based on business cost rather than convenience.

nodes.title: Bias-Variance & Regularized Regression
nodes.description: The bias-variance trade-off and L1/L2 regularized linear models.

nodes.title: Bias-Variance Trade-off
nodes.description: Underfitting vs overfitting, high bias vs high variance, and how model complexity changes generalization.

nodes.title: Ridge Regression (L2)
nodes.description: Penalty on squared coefficients, geometric intuition of shrinking coefficients, and the effect of lambda on bias and variance.

nodes.title: Lasso Regression (L1)
nodes.description: Penalty on absolute coefficients, sparsity, and Lasso as embedded feature selection.

nodes.title: Elastic Net
nodes.description: Combines L1 and L2 regularization using alpha and L1-ratio for sparsity with correlated predictors.

nodes.title: Ensemble Learning
nodes.description: Voting, bagging, random forests, boosting and stacking.

nodes.title: Voting Ensembles
nodes.description: Why combining diverse models can improve generalization; hard voting vs soft voting.

nodes.title: Bagging
nodes.description: Bootstrap sampling and parallel learners for variance reduction.

nodes.title: Random Forest
nodes.description: Bagged trees + random feature subsampling, out-of-bag score, GridSearchCV / RandomizedSearchCV and feature importance.

nodes.title: AdaBoost
nodes.description: Sequential weak learners increasing focus on misclassified examples.

nodes.title: Gradient Boosting
nodes.description: Stage-wise additive modeling with residual / negative-gradient correction.

nodes.title: XGBoost
nodes.description: Boosted-tree objective and regularization intuition with second-order optimization.

nodes.title: Stacking & Blending
nodes.description: Base learners and meta-learner using out-of-fold predictions to avoid leakage.

nodes.title: Clustering & Dimensionality Reduction
nodes.description: Centroid, hierarchical and density-based clustering plus the curse of dimensionality and PCA.

nodes.title: K-Means Clustering
nodes.description: Centroid-based clustering objective, assignment and centroid-update steps, and choosing the number of clusters.

nodes.title: Agglomerative Hierarchical Clustering
nodes.description: Bottom-up merging process, linkage concept and dendrogram interpretation.

nodes.title: DBSCAN
nodes.description: Density-based clustering with core, border and noise points, eps and min_samples.

nodes.title: Curse of Dimensionality
nodes.description: Distance concentration and sparse high-dimensional spaces, and motivation for feature selection and dimensionality reduction.

nodes.title: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
nodes.description: Rotate to directions of maximum variance using covariance matrix, eigenvectors and explained variance.

nodes.title: Hyperparameter Tuning & Reliable Experiments
nodes.description: Search strategies and experiment hygiene for reproducible, leakage-free experiments.

nodes.title: Search strategies
nodes.description: Train/validation/test split discipline, cross-validation, GridSearchCV, RandomizedSearchCV, Optuna and Bayesian optimization.

nodes.title: Experiment hygiene
nodes.description: Put preprocessing inside pipelines, set random seeds, record dataset version and parameters, and use a simple baseline.

nodes.title: Neural Network Fundamentals
nodes.description: The perceptron, multi-layer perceptrons, loss functions and backpropagation.

nodes.title: Perceptron
nodes.description: Artificial neuron vs perceptron, geometric decision-boundary intuition and the perceptron update rule.

nodes.title: Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP / ANN)
nodes.description: Layer notation, forward propagation, and TensorFlow/Keras workflow for classification and regression networks.

nodes.title: Loss Functions
nodes.description: Regression losses vs classification losses and loss as the scalar objective optimized by gradient descent.

nodes.title: Backpropagation
nodes.description: Chain-rule flow from loss to each parameter, forward cache, and why gradients vanish or explode.

nodes.title: Optimization, Activations & Regularization
nodes.description: Training deep networks: gradient descent, activations, initialization, regularization and optimizers.

nodes.title: Gradient Descent in Neural Networks
nodes.description: Batch, stochastic and mini-batch training, learning rate, batch size and vanishing/exploding gradients.

nodes.title: Activation Functions
nodes.description: Sigmoid and saturation, Tanh, ReLU and dead-neuron issue, and Leaky ReLU, PReLU, ELU and SELU.

nodes.title: Initialization
nodes.description: Xavier / Glorot initialization, He initialization for ReLU-family activations, and gradient stability.

nodes.title: Regularization & Generalization
nodes.description: Early stopping, dropout, L1 / L2 regularization and weight decay, and batch normalization.

nodes.title: Optimizers
nodes.description: Momentum, Nesterov Accelerated Gradient, AdaGrad, RMSProp and Adam trade-offs.

nodes.title: Neural Network Hyperparameter Tuning
nodes.description: Learning rate, units, layers, batch size, dropout and optimizer with the Keras Tuner workflow.

nodes.title: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)
nodes.description: CNN intuition, the convolution operation, pooling, CNN architecture and backpropagation, augmentation and transfer learning.

nodes.title: CNN Intuition
nodes.description: Why dense ANNs are inefficient for images: local connectivity, receptive fields and parameter sharing.

nodes.title: Convolution Operation
nodes.description: Filters / kernels sliding over input, feature maps and channels, stride and padding, and output-shape calculation.

nodes.title: Pooling
nodes.description: Max pooling and downsampling, effect on spatial resolution and robustness.

nodes.title: CNN Architecture & Backpropagation
nodes.description: LeNet-5 as a canonical architecture and backpropagation through convolution, max-pooling and flatten layers.

nodes.title: Data Augmentation & Transfer Learning
nodes.description: Geometric / photometric augmentation, ImageNet / ILSVRC pretrained models, feature extraction vs fine-tuning.

nodes.title: RNN, LSTM & GRU
nodes.description: Recurrent networks for sequence data, including LSTM, GRU and bidirectional variants.

nodes.title: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN)
nodes.description: Hidden-state recurrence and forward propagation, sequence-to-label patterns and Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT).

nodes.title: LSTM
nodes.description: Cell state and hidden state, forget, input and output gates, and next-word prediction.

nodes.title: GRU
nodes.description: Reset and update gates, simpler state structure than LSTM, and trade-offs between GRU and LSTM.

nodes.title: Deep & Bidirectional Recurrent Networks
nodes.description: Stacked / deep RNNs, LSTMs and GRUs, and bidirectional RNN, BiLSTM and BiGRU.

nodes.title: Seq2Seq, Attention & Transformers
nodes.description: Encoder-decoder sequence-to-sequence, the attention mechanism, and the full transformer architecture.

nodes.title: Encoder-Decoder / Sequence-to-Sequence
nodes.description: Encoder compresses the input sequence into a representation, decoder generates the output, and the bottleneck problem of fixed-size context vectors.

nodes.title: Attention Mechanism
nodes.description: Attention scores, weights and context vector; Bahdanau (additive) vs Luong (multiplicative) attention.

nodes.title: Transformer Foundations
nodes.description: Self-attention with Query, Key and Value, scaled dot-product attention, and multi-head attention.

nodes.title: Positional Encoding & Layer Normalization
nodes.description: Sinusoidal positional encodings and layer normalization versus batch normalization.

nodes.title: Transformer Encoder
nodes.description: Token embedding + positional information, multi-head self-attention, residual connections + layer normalization, feed-forward network, stacking encoder blocks.

nodes.title: Transformer Decoder & Inference
nodes.description: Masked self-attention / causal attention, cross-attention to encoder output, and autoregressive token-by-token inference.
